messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":18,"source_ref":"18:2","text":"and there will I be, until I die.' And she began to walk towards the western parts and to mourn"},{"chapter":18,"source_ref":"18:3","text":"and to weep bitterly and groan aloud. And she made there a booth, while she had in her womb offspring of three months old."},{"chapter":19,"source_ref":"19:1","text":"And when the time of her bearing approached, she began to be distressed with pains, and she"},{"chapter":19,"source_ref":"19:2","text":"cried aloud to the Lord and said: 'Pity me, O Lord, assist me.' And she was not heard and the"},{"chapter":19,"source_ref":"19:3","text":"mercy of God did not encircle her. And she said to herself: 'Who shall tell my lord Adam I implore you, ye luminaries of heaven, what time ye return to the east, bear a message to my lord Adam.'"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 18:2, 18:3, 19:1, 19:2, 19:3.
